name: Mooreast Holdings Ltd.
summary: Mooreast Holdings Ltd., a subsidiary of Feng Tai Investment Pte. Ltd. and established in Singapore in 2021, delivers specialized mooring solutions to clients across an extensive global reach, including Singapore, Europe, the Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and Oceania. The company's operations are structured into several distinct segments: The Mooring division offers comprehensive services, from the initial design and engineering to fabrication, supply, installation, and commissioning of mooring systems for the offshore oil and gas and broader marine sectors. This segment also provides leasing options for these systems. Through its Rigging and Heavy Lifting segment, Mooreast supplies a variety of critical equipment, such as steel and synthetic ropes and chains, serving the offshore O&G, marine, renewable energy, and construction industries. The Marine Supplies and Services segment distributes essential mooring components, including synthetic ropes, shackles, chains, anchors, and deck equipment, to the marine industry. A dedicated Renewable Energy segment focuses on sustainable solutions, providing end-to-end services—design, engineering, fabrication, supply, installation, and commissioning—for mooring systems specifically adapted for floating wind farms, offshore solar photovoltaic installations, and tidal turbine projects. Finally, the Yard segment performs on-board fabrication, repair, and testing of equipment for marine vessels.
